biggest_catch: Requires a 2010-or-newer insured vehicle in your name — and visits depend on demand in your market.
catches: Requires a valid US driver's license and an insured vehicle (2010 or newer) in your name.
Must pass a background check, motor vehicle report, and Papa Safety Training.
Visit availability varies by market; pay and mileage depend on your location.
Visits are typically 2-4 hours; you only earn for completed visits.
